title.narrative: «Providing emergency humanitarian assistance to people affected by hostilities in the East of Ukraine»

description.narrative: ltpgtWithin the framework of this project, it is planned to implement two components, one - in the direction of FSLC will be implemented in the Luhansk NGCA, the second - in the direction of Shelter - in the Donetsk NGCA.ltbrgtAs part of the first component, it is planned to provide assistance to 900 households located in the NGCA in the Luhansk region and engaged in agricultural activities in the form of 900 kits of agricultural tools and equipment. Assistance will be distributed to beneficiaries who are internally displaced or have destroyed homes, with additional categories of vulnerability: female heads of household large families single parents parents raising disabled children households with dependent disabled people of groups 1 and 2 single pensioners 65+.ltbrgtBeneficiaries will be offered a choice of four kits (during pre-verification of lists) from which they can choose the one that suits them, within the framework of their agricultural activities and existing needs. The average cost of support per small family farm is $500.ltbrgtThe second component of the project: provision of 1200 NFI kits for 1200 households located at the NGCA in the Donetsk region. The composition of NFI kits is based on the recommendations of the SNFI Cluster and consists of the following components: bed linen, blankets, a set of towels, a set of kitchen utensils, a drinking water canister and a bucket.ltbrgtMain categories of beneficiaries: internally displaced persons or persons with partially or completely destroyed housing, with additional categories of vulnerability: single pensioners 65+, female heads of households, single parents, families with disabled children. The cost of supporting one household is $255.ltbrgtThe project is designed for implementation within 7 months, the place of implementation is the entire territory of the Donetsk and Lugansk NGCA, both as of 02/24/2022, and in the territory of the Donetsk and Luhansk regions, which have an uncertain status after 02/24/2022, to which there is access from the outside N.G.C.A.ltbrgtThe total preliminary budget will be $958,618.78, of which $527,240.90 is FSL costs (55% of the total budget) and $431,378.45 is SNFI costs (45% of the total budget).Currently, HADC is implementing three projects with UHF funding. The actual implementation of the CBPF-UKR-23-R-NGO-26250 project will be completed before the end of January 2024 (final reporting by HADC is planned for February 2024). Accordingly, HADC will have two projects left (the completion of which is planned in February-March), which gives us the right to submit this application and take on the project, which in March will become our third with UHF financing, and from April will remain the only project that will be implemented with UHF funding.ltbrgtlt/pgt
